messages:
lina: Quick heads-up — after flipping AWQ two-pass + per-channel quant on the rtx pool for the new rwd-t5x-v3 candidate, our nightly SQL->NL EM on tablex dropped ~8%. Can someone with the quant suite look? :eyes:

kevin: which candidate + quant path? AWQ only or hybrid FP8 fallback?

lina: Candidate: rwd-t5x-v3 (new tokenizer). Quant: awq/2pass/per-channel, int8 fallback disabled. Nightly id 2026-03-19-23:45 with seed=42.

ml-ci-bot: nightly run posted: https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/2056789123
Summary:
- tablex EM: baseline 72.4 -> candidate 64.3 (-8.1)
- summarization ROUGE unchanged
- sql-exec exact matches: -6.2

kevin: can you paste quant config?

lina: ```yaml
quant:
  method: awq
  passes: 2
  per_channel: true
  fallback: none
  calibrate_batches: 2048
runtime:
  batch_size: 8
  kv_cache: enabled
  dtype: fp16
```

anya: did tokenization change? new tokenizer could break table->text alignment.

lina: yes we switched to sentencepiece-v2 for smaller vocab. Example diff:
gold: "Total revenue: $1,234"
pred_old: "Total revenue: $1,234"
pred_new: "Total revenue : $1 , 234 "
Formatting spaces inserted around punctuation -> hurts exact-match.

raj: hmm could be quant amplifying tokenization sensitivity. Can you run quick 'quant-bisect' comparing awq vs fp8 vs gptq?

kevin: run with fixed seed + disable caching to isolate kv artifacts:
`./tools/run_quant_bisect.sh --models rwd-t5x-v3 --modes fp8,gptq,awq --seed 42 --kv-cache off --small-eval tablex`

ml-ci-bot: queued job #2056789130

lina: queued. also logging: /artifacts/2056789123/attn-diffs.log small snippet:
```
step 87: attn_weights diff L2 0.012 -> spikes at tokens 14-18
trace: kv-cache hit pattern mismatch when per-channel scaling applied
```

anya: try disabling per-channel quant to see if that's the lever.

kevin: also check batch size change (8->1) — continuous batching can hide tokenization shifts.

lina: ok will run 3 quick probes and post results.

ml-ci-bot: results posted 2056789199:
- awq/per-channel: tablex -8.1
- awq/global-scale: tablex -3.2
- fp8: tablex -1.0
- gptq: tablex -0.9

lina: looks like per-channel AWQ is main culprit. Reverting per-channel for rollout, and open PR to add tokenizer-preserving eval. Reassigning to @kevin for rollout patch. :white_check_mark:

kevin: on it, patch incoming. Can we gate awq/per-channel behind canary?

anya: +1 to canary.

lina: thx team.
